in_text_mentions: Despite these findings (Figures 1, 2), the patient did not exhibit symptoms typically associated with PNCS, such as intermittent hematuria, pelvic pain, left lower back pain, costovertebral angle tenderness, elevated serum creatinine, orthostatic proteinuria, or varicocele. Due to the patient's obesity, a Doppler ultrasound to assess the flow dynamics of the LRV was not feasible.

This confirmed critical stenosis of the LRV and pelvic varicose veins on the left, with a discretely dilated gonadal vein (Figures 2 -4).
